digital-clubhouse-2026-11-26.description: The go-to ecommerce event in the North for education, networking and inspiration. A morning of 1:1 talks and a panel on what ecommerce looks like in 2027, in the cinema at Department, Leeds Dock — with breakfast, lunch and networking. Just 60 tickets per event. Speakers include Karl Lloyd (Praevo Partners), Mark Taylor (Retail Solutions) and Hannah Johnson.
digital-clubhouse-2026-11-26.venue: Cinema @ Department, Leeds Dock, 4 The Boulevard, LS10 1PZ
